expected_outcomes: Domain rules, persistence, authorization, migrations, retention, deletion, jobs, backups, and recovery are explicit and tested.
required_actions: Enforce trusted-boundary authorization and validation; define transactions, migrations, retention, deletion, backup, restore, and data-quality controls.
expected_documents: Data model, data inventory, migration plan, retention schedule, access matrix, backup and restore plan, runbook, and quality checks.
acceptance: Migrations have recovery, retention and deletion are executable, and required backup restoration is tested.
verification: Run unit, integration, migration, authorization, concurrency, restore, retention, deletion, and data-quality tests.
evidence: Schemas, migration output, test results, restore evidence, access review, and operational dashboards.
failure_conditions: Unbounded retention, orphaned personal data, untested restore, missing authorization, destructive migration without rollback, or silent job loss.
exceptions: Document data affected, risk, temporary control, owner, approval, and expiry.
